num_designs.description: Number of designs to generate per seed.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for the diffusion reverse process.

length_range.description: Min/max residue length of the designed binder.

ligand.description: Optional path to a ligand file (SDF or PDB) that the binder should be designed around. BoltzGen is ligand-aware and co-designs the binding pocket with side chains in one pass.

target_chain.description: Chain id of the target in the input PDB.
